659:t_005:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「If all you can think about is wiping us out, then we're not backing down either!」

659:t_005:9.en:
$n
「We're not about to just sit here and get killed either!」

659:t_005:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Kill or be killed, then I'm not holding back! I'll settle this right here, right now, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

659:t_005:11.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Wait and see, Earthlings! Until the factor of the Great Void fills us!」

659:t_005:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「That moment will be your end! And then we will gain the power of $$シンカ$$!」

659:t_006:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「You act all cool, and in the end you run away!?」

659:t_006:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「It seems they intend to buy time by using their $$インベーダー#pilot$$ underlings.」

659:t_006:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Bring it on! Whether you're a starving destroyer or the incarnation of endless destruction, I'll take down everything that blocks our way!」

659:t_006:3.en:
$$凱$$
「This is the critical moment! Let's do it, everyone!」

659:t_006:4.en:
$$渓$$
「You just wait, $$コーウェン$$, $$スティンガー$$! We'll never lose!」

659:t_006:5.en:
$$號$$
「We will live! That's exactly the power that will break the Great Void!!」

659:t_007:1.en:
$$渓$$
「Here they come... You mean $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$!」

659:t_007:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The big bosses have finally shown up!」

659:t_008:0.en:
$$凱$$
「For all the buildup, this isn't much different from the $$再世戦争$$!」

659:t_008:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Do not underestimate our power, Earthling.」

659:t_008:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is the space of the Great Void! You who dwell within the laws of the force that seeks to exist cannot win!」

659:t_009:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Four more of those things showed up!」

659:t_009:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Clones!? Or are they the same type!?」

659:t_009:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That is not so, Earthling.」

659:t_009:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are all us.」

659:t_009:5.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is the space of the Great Void... All of its laws differ from the outside world.」

659:t_009:6.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We who hold that factor are beings who are one in all, and all in one.」

659:t_009:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A world with different laws... So that means they use $$次元力$$ too.」

659:t_009:9.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You stand at the entrance to $$シンカ$$, yet you still seem not to have realized the essence of $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

659:t_009:10.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「As I thought, the $$ゲッター線$$ does choose us.」

659:t_009:13.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We cannot tell you that.」

659:t_009:14.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But take comfort. You will gain eternity within us.」

659:t_009:16.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You, who are close to obtaining the truth, and we, who have gained the essence of $$オリジン・ロー$$...」

659:t_009:17.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Combine those two, and the strongest species in the universe will surely be born!」

659:t_009:18.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Yes! It is the fusion of the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist!」

659:t_009:19.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Now, Earthlings! Offer your souls and your steel bodies to us!」

659:t_010:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm not handing our lives over to the likes of $$バアル$$!」

659:t_010:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Do not call us $$バアル$$!」

659:t_010:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No! You really are $$バアル$$, after all!」

659:t_010:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「No! You really are $$バアル$$, after all!」

659:t_010:4.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「No! You really are $$バアル$$, after all!」

659:t_010:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I did think maybe we could talk it out... but being friends with you looks totally out of the question.」

659:t_010:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You do nothing but take other lives for your own desires. You have no right to live in this universe.」

659:t_010:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And on top of that, you're drowning in the Great Void... in the force that seeks to vanish!」

659:t_010:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you're going to destroy the universe with that power, you're humanity's natural enemy... $$バアル$$!」

659:t_010:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Whether the $$御使い$$s knew that, or it turned out that way because they decided you were $$バアル$$, doesn't matter now that we've come this far.」

659:t_010:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you're going to take our lives for the sake of your own evolution, we'll resist with everything we've got!」

659:t_010:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't give a damn about gods or devils, vanishing or existing!」

659:t_010:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm just going to fight to the death against anyone who won't let me live!」

659:t_010:13.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Don't think you can win, Earthling!」

659:t_010:14.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is the space of the Great Void...! Having gained its power, we are invincible!」

659:t_010:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Now that we've come this far, we don't need any big talk!」

659:t_010:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「Us against you...! It's a contest over which of us survives!」

659:t_010:17.en:
$$凱$$
「But we won't lose! We can't afford to lose!」

659:t_010:18.en:
$$渓$$
「We're different from you, spreading destruction everywhere! We have something we're carrying!」

659:t_010:19.en:
$$號$$
「That's exactly what you'll never reach! The truth of those who live in this universe!」

659:t_010:20.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's a showdown, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Even in the world of the Great Void, I'm here... We're here!」

659:t_010:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「As long as we're alive, I won't hand this world over to the likes of the Great Void!!」

659:t_011:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Impossible! Why can't we win!?」

659:t_011:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Are we not the chosen species that holds the factor of the Great Void and was blessed by the $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_011:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「There's no such thing as being chosen or not chosen by life! You tried to wipe out other living things on your own, and you just got hit back for it!」

659:t_011:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Silence, silence! Either way, you are finished too!」

659:t_011:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「The Great Void will fill this universe! Once it does, the universe itself will perish!」

659:t_012:5.en:
$$早乙女$$
(Remember. The days when we studied the $$ゲッター線$$ together.)

659:t_012:7.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That form! You were absorbed by the $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_012:8.en:
$$早乙女$$
(I was not absorbed. We became one.)

659:t_012:9.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Have you come to laugh at us, who cannot attain $$シンカ$$!」

659:t_012:10.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Why!? Why can't we grasp the truth!?」

659:t_012:11.en:
$$早乙女$$
(If you remember what you have forgotten, you can arrive there too.)

kept_omissions: 659:t_009:4: Invaders' 'We are all us' - kept as in source.
659:t_012:5,8,11 and t_011:6, t_012:2: Saotome's telepathic thoughts - addressees taken from scene (Invaders / Genki); imperatives left without an explicit 'you'.
659:t_010:9: 御使い rendered as plural '$$御使い$$s' (plural/singular unsettled in source).
uncertain: 659:t_011:6: (もういい、元気) read as Saotome speaking to Genki/Kei ('That's enough now, Genki'), based on t_012:28 in slice 03 where Saotome says 達者でな、元気…いや、渓よ; 'That's enough' vs 'It's all right now' is a call.
真化 rendered with token $$シンカ$$ ('Shinka') to match Shinka Fusion; other slices might use 'True Evolution'.
659:t_009:2: 分身 rendered 'Clones' (not 'avatar'), since the Invaders say they are not copies.
659:t_009:4: 我等は全て我等だ rendered literally 'We are all us.'
Used keyword tokens in plain speech: $$ゲッター線$$, $$オリジン・ロー$$, $$次元力$$, $$再世戦争$$, $$バアル$$, $$シンカ$$.
